messages.author: bdf06bf43d40b236
messages.subject: Horizontal Transformation
parts:
Hello there,
I suspect there's an easy solution to this problem I just am not certain on the search terms.

I'd like to transform a dataframe that looks like this:

Patient # rx#     rxstart      rxend          duration overlap
99           1      2013-03-26     2013-03-26     1       0
99           2      2013-03-27     2013-03-27     1       0
99           3      2013-03-27     2013-03-27     1       1
222         21      2013-03-01     2013-03-30     x       a

222         22      2013-03-01     2013-03-28     y       b


to look like this:

Patient #           rxstart1         rxend1      rxstart2           rxend2    rxstart3          rxend3
99                   2013-03-26     2013-03-26     2013-03-27     2013-03-27   2013-03-27     2013-03-27
222                  2013-03-01     2013-03-30    2013-03-01     2013-03-28    null               null

There's an undefined number of rx's per patient.

Does this make sense? I'd like to calculate a total drug exposure excluding overlapping dates for eatch patient.

Hope you can help,
Tom
